question: How does the Bhairava scripture become an eight-times-eight system within Śiva?
premises: The teaching enters the right, emissive, heart, and autonomous aspects in Śiva.
The sixteenfold structure is further articulated.
The scripture named Bhairava becomes eight-times-eight simultaneously.
inference: By entering the autonomous Śiva through its right, emissive, and heart aspects, the Bhairava scripture unfolds simultaneously as an eight-times-eight system.
uncertainties: The technical mapping of dakṣa, vaisargika, hārda, and svatantra to the full eight-times-eight structure is compressed in this verse.
plain_english: Entering the right, emissive, heart, and autonomous aspects in Śiva, the scripture named Bhairava becomes simultaneously an eight-times-eight system.
